# Interview Sarthi

> InterviewSarthi is four apps, one for each step of a job hunt. Apply Sarthi is a Windows app that finds jobs on different job portals and applies to them for you automatically (free every week). Prep Sarthi runs spoken mock interviews about your own CV (free 7-minute demo, no sign-up, works on a phone). Live Sarthi shows answer suggestions from your own resume during interview calls on Windows, on a panel that supported screen sharing does not show (30 minutes free). Meeting Sarthi helps in client meetings with live captions and a short reply from your own project (captions and recaps free). The homepage at https://interviewsarthi.com/ explains all four. Paid passes are one-time and never renew. Prices are given in rupees for India and in US dollars for everyone else; Apply Sarthi's plans are in rupees. Built and run by an independent developer in India. Facts reviewed 11 November 2026.

Product and guide pages contain readable HTML. Interactive app features require JavaScript. Facts pages carry review dates and a corrections address.

## The products

- [Apply Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/apply/): A Windows app (Windows 10 and 11) that applies to jobs for you, automatically. You add your CV once, say which jobs you want, sign in to your job sites inside the app's own browser window and press Start applying. It finds jobs that fit your CV on Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Shine, Foundit and company career pages, fills each application with your details and your saved answers, attaches a CV tailored to the job when a form asks for one, and sends it; "fill only" mode fills each form and leaves Submit to you. A question only you can answer waits under "For you to finish". It never solves "are you human" checks, never stores job-site passwords, and keeps a safe daily pace on every site. Uses your own free Google Gemini key. Free every week: 20 applications in the first week, then 15 every week. For more, plans paid once for 30 days through Cashfree (no auto-debit): Basic Rs 249 (up to 300 applications a month), Pro Rs 499 (up to 1,000, with a free Prep Sarthi month), Max Rs 799 (up to 2,000, with a free Prep Sarthi month); only applications that are sent count. It is being published on the Microsoft Store: until the Store link is on the page, https://interviewsarthi.com/apply/ takes an email address and sends the link. Free public job lists, with no account, are at https://apply.interviewsarthi.com/jobs. Best for: getting applications sent without filling forms yourself.
- [Prep Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/): Web app for phones and computers, at https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/app/. An AI interviewer asks spoken questions built from your CV and the job you want, follows up on weak answers, and writes a report with a score, what was missing and a stronger answer for each question. Free 7-minute demo interview with no sign-up and no key. Then one 30-day pass: Rs 99 (USD 9.99), unlimited mock interviews, paid once, never renews; after buying, you add your own free Google Gemini key in a one-minute setup. Invite friends: a friend who buys through your link gets 37 days on their first pass and you get 7 free days (give a week, get a week). Company practice pages: TCS NQT, Infosys, Cognizant GenC, Capgemini. Best for: rehearsing out loud before a real interview.
- [Live Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/live/): The Interview Sarthi Windows app (Windows 10 version 2004 or later, Windows 11), from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NMKQPSQ1KS8. It hears interview questions on Teams, Zoom, Google Meet and other call apps and drafts answer suggestions from your CV, in English, Hindi or Hinglish. Setup also takes the job description and your own examples (both optional): answers use the role's words and your real stories, and when nothing fits, the app offers an example set inside a real job from your resume and marks it on the card as made up, so you can adapt it. Every window of the app, not only the answer panel, is hidden from supported screen sharing. Answers start in about 1 second; timing varies. Uses your own free Gemini key. 30 minutes free per device, then one-time passes with unlimited use: 2 days Rs 149 (USD 9.99), 30 days on 2 devices Rs 299 (USD 29.99). In India, Rs 299 buys 30 days of unlimited live interview help on two computers, paid once, with no subscription and no per-minute credits; that costs less than a month of every international AI interview assistant in our comparison (Final Round AI, LockedIn AI, Cluely, Parakeet AI, Verve AI, OphyAI; checked 12 November 2026: https://interviewsarthi.com/best-ai-interview-assistant-india.html#unlimited-price). Includes Prep Sarthi (₹99) free for 30 days · until 30 Nov 2026. Sign in to Prep with the same Gmail used to buy Live, or paste the Live key on Prep’s Passes screen. A pass's days start when you activate its key, not when you pay; 7-day money-back on a first pass. Refer a friend: when a friend buys a pass with your invite code and activates it, you both get a Free Interview Day (24 hours on one computer, starting when you activate it). Use assistance only where interview rules permit it.
- [Meeting Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/meeting/): A Windows app for client meetings, from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NCZPS7XMDR1. In a meeting on Teams, Zoom, Google Meet or any other app it shows live captions of what is said, which helps when an accent is hard to follow, and a short reply to what the client just asked, built from the user's own project: confirmed notes and documents (PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint, text, a connected folder; Git, GitHub and Jira read-only). Afterwards it drafts a recap and action items for the user to confirm. It never joins the meeting. By default its windows are left out of supported screen sharing and recordings on Windows 10 (2004 or later) and Windows 11; this can be turned off in Settings. A practice call built from the user's own project shows how it works. Runs on the user's own Gemini key; projects, notes, documents and transcripts stay on the PC. Captions, recaps, notes, documents, briefs and practice calls are free; live answers get 30 free minutes per computer, then a 30-day pass on 2 computers for Rs 299 in India (USD 29.99 elsewhere), paid once, never renews, no refunds after purchase. Best for: answering a client's question from your own project during a meeting.
- [Resume-based mock interview walkthrough](https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/mock-interview-from-resume.html): CV and job-description setup, spoken practice and how to use feedback.
- [Public job directory](https://apply.interviewsarthi.com/jobs): job details, company pages and role categories; availability changes as employers update listings.

## Live Sarthi setup and testing

- Best: wired earphones, or the laptop's own speaker and mic, in your meeting app. Bluetooth earphones? Disconnect them, and use wired earphones or the laptop's own speaker and mic in your meeting app. In Interview Sarthi, click setup and keep both sound boxes on Automatic.
- Got a one-word or half answer? Someone spoke while the app was answering. Ask the interviewer to repeat the question; the full answer also follows by itself.
- Sound stops during a call? In Interview Sarthi, click more, then reconnect. Keep your meeting open. Open Interview Sarthi once; clicking its icon again brings the same window forward. The message box grows to fit its text; drag the small grip below it to change its height, or double-click the grip to let it grow automatically again.
- Test before your interview: open Interview Sarthi once, put on earphones and [open the AI interviewer](https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/app/?from=livesarthi). Add your resume and press Start. When the interviewer asks a question, check that a suggested answer appears in Interview Sarthi. Best: wired earphones, or the laptop's own speaker and mic. Bluetooth earphones? Disconnect them. Testing alone with the practice page or a phone? Answer when it asks; if the interviewer talks over an answer, the full answer follows in a moment. If you test from your phone instead, keep the phone away from the laptop, or the app hears you twice. Ask interview questions in English or Hindi. [Setup and troubleshooting help](https://interviewsarthi.com/help.html).

## Interviewing abroad (for Indians applying to jobs in other countries)

- [Job interviews abroad for Indians](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/job-interviews-abroad-indians.html): what changes in the US, UK, Canada and UAE compared with Indian interviews.
- [US job interviews for Indians](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/us-job-interview-tips-indians.html): recruiter screens, STAR answers, salary research, thank-you emails.
- [UK job interviews for Indians](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/uk-job-interview-tips-indians.html): competency-based questions, right to work, the sponsor register.
- [Canada job interviews for Indians](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/canada-job-interview-tips-indians.html): the Canadian experience question, behavioural rounds, references.
- [Dubai and UAE job interviews for Indians](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/dubai-uae-job-interview-tips-indians.html): monthly packages, gratuity on basic pay, notice periods, fake offers.
- [Germany job interviews for Indians](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/germany-job-interview-tips-indians.html): structured format, German-language questions, annual gross salary, probation.
- [Australia job interviews for Indians](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/australia-job-interview-tips-indians.html): behavioural questions, local experience, salary plus super, referees.
- [NHS interview questions for Indian nurses](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/nhs-interview-questions-indian-nurses.html): values-based and scenario questions, NEWS2, SBAR, safeguarding.
- [Amazon Leadership Principles interview](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/amazon-leadership-principles-interview.html): the 16 principles, likely questions, STAR answers, the Bar Raiser.
- [STAR method with examples](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/star-method-interview-answers.html): behavioural interview answers, a story bank and follow-ups.
- [Will you require visa sponsorship?](https://interviewsarthi.com/guides/visa-sponsorship-interview-question.html): honest answers for OPT, H-1B, the UK Graduate route, Canadian work permits and the UAE.
